$comment: #EXP-1785 (Danny, 2026-11-11: 'the session header in chats has to show the open plans and questions again: the waiting asks/plans of that session and of its child sessions'; AMENDS everything below that disagrees). WHY THEY WERE GONE: #EXP-1732 (session-screen.json) deleted the chip strip, and the chips lived in it. THEY ARE BACK ON THE SESSION SCREEN'S HEADER ×4 (session-screen.json HEADER), for a chat, an agent's conversation and the Assistant (an app's editor keeps its header as is: its asks reach the person through Needs you), unchanged look: `waitingChips(cards, phone)` over THE TREE's waiting cards = ask-dock `chatPendingAsks` (every waiting plan AND question of the root AND of every session under it, Conversation order; PLANS ARE CHIPS AGAIN: the plan tab is gone). WHERE: WIDE (web ≥ md, the IDE) = the `chips` side by side at the START of the header's trailing slot (after the tabs, before the merge pill / call / gear / `…`), shrinking and truncating before the tabs do; PHONES (iOS, Android, web-mobile) = the ONE `button` at the start of the header's trailing slot (before the gear / `…`), opening THE Menu (the bottom sheet) of its rows; an opened item's pushed page (session-screen.json PHONE ITEM) has its own header, no button. Nothing waits = nothing drawn. A PICK (`waitingTarget(card, rootId)`, every mirror replays `targetCases` comparing the WHOLE value; the card input gains its asking `sessionId`): a `plan` = {open: `plan`, sessionId} = THE plan page as the screen's opened item (session-screen.json `open: plan`, plan-page.json, any session's plan); a `question` of the ROOT = {open: `card`, sessionId} = the Chat tab (phones: the opened item closes, the Chat tab shows) SCROLLED to that card, centred, with the highlight ring below; a question of a session UNDER the root = {open: `session`, sessionId} = THAT session opened in place (session-screen.json `open: session`) scrolled to its card, centred, with the same ring. The card it reaches is THE existing card (plan-card.json / ask-dock.json, #EXP-1464), answerable there; no second ask UI. NO FEED ×4: the transcript may be a placeholder (steer-enet.json: the device is away, `No live transcript`, connecting, an ended run's offline line) and then has no card to reach, so while a session view shows ANY no-feed placeholder its OWN WAITING cards (ask-dock `sessionCards` that wait, card order) draw UNDER the placeholder in the transcript column, in the slot of the suggested tasks and queued messages, answerable like inline ones (the answer path never needs the device); a pick scrolls to and rings them there too. A chip therefore never dead-ends. Only existing components: StripChip, Menu, MenuRow, the cards (genUI catalogue). #EXP-1662: a waiting PLAN has no chip here: it is the strip's plan tab (plan-page.json); chips list the questions, and a plan's × sits on its Conversation row. #EXP-1561 / #EXP-1562 (owner 2026-11-01, Danny): WAITING question and plan cards ×4 (TS reference src/waiting-cards.ts; desktop crates/domain waiting_cards.rs, iOS ExpCore WaitingCards.swift, Android domain/WaitingCards.kt replay `stateCases`, `dismissCases` (the server's, TS only) and `chipCases`, comparing the WHOLE expected value). CARD STATE `cardState(card, answeredAt)`: null unless the card is a `plan` or `question`; `dismissed` when `card.dismissed` is true or `card.decision` is `dismissed` (a plan); a plan: `superseded` (ask-dock.json FEED-140), `answered` (any other decision), else `waiting`; a question: `answered` once `answeredAt` or a string `answer` is set, else `waiting`. Only `waiting` cards are answerable, are listed in Needs you (needs-you.json) and get a chip. DISMISS (#EXP-1561): every WAITING question and plan card in a conversation (the chat's inline card and the session view's, on every platform) carries ONE small ghost × (`icons.dismiss`, accessible name `copy.dismiss`, `testIds.dismiss`) at the TOP-RIGHT of its header row; a press dismisses at once (no confirm) through THE answer path: `sessions.answer({messageId, dismissed: true})` (a parent or watcher: `sessions_send({sessionId, answer: {dismissed: true, messageId?}})`). The server stamps `dismissedCard(card)` (`dismissCases`: a question gains `dismissed: true`; a plan gains `dismissed: true`, `decision: 'dismissed'`, `fresh: false`; a SEALED card keeps its envelope and gains the same clear fields + `answered: true`) with `answered_at` under the same unanswered guard as an answer (the first answer or dismiss wins, the later one is CONFLICT), so it syncs to every device through the messages shape. The asking agent hears it like an answer: the device delivers plan-card.json `answerText.dismissedQuestion` / `answerText.dismissedPlan` as its next turn (an engine's relay ask is declined: a permission ask picks its reject option, an elicitation is answered with that text), so the agent never waits on it. A DISMISSED card draws as ONE quiet muted line (`testIds.dismissed`): the kind icon + `copy.dismissed` + the card's title (ask-dock `askDockTitle`, a question's text), truncated, no body, no ×, no options (the superseded line's look). ask-dock `planDecisionLabel('dismissed')` = `copy.dismissed`. CHIPS (#EXP-1562): `waitingChips(cards, phone)` over the conversation's WAITING cards in Conversation order (a chat: ask-dock `chatPendingAsks`; the session view: ask-dock `sessionCards` that wait), each {id, kind, text}. `layout` = `hidden` when none waits (nothing drawn, no placeholder), `button` on phones (iOS, Android, web-mobile), else `chips`; `count` = the number waiting; `chips` = one per card {id, kind, icon (`icons[kind]`), label = askDockTitle(text) clipped to `constants.labelMax` characters (longer = the first labelMax − 1, trailing spaces trimmed, + `constants.ellipsis`), an empty title = ask-dock `askDockLabel(kind)`}. WHERE: the chat header's ONE strip (session-chat.json STRIP), RIGHT AFTER the Conversation tab (no Conversation tab = first in the tablist), before the issue/group zone. `chips` = THE StripChip (the strip chip box, entity-chip.json tab size) per chip: lead = the kind icon tinted with the ask-dock plan/question tint, label = `label`, `testIds.chip`, the full title as its tooltip; they sit side by side in the zone's row (they shrink and truncate before the zone does). `button` = ONE icon-only StripChip (`icons.waiting` tinted with the question tint, the count beside it muted, `testIds.button`, accessible name `copy.waitingCount`) opening THE Menu (the phones' bottom sheet, like the strip group's) titled `copy.waiting` whose rows (`testIds.menu` + `-row`) = THE MenuRow per chip in order: the kind icon tinted, `label` as the title, ask-dock `askDockLabel(kind)` muted as the caption; a pick closes the sheet. A chip or a row SCROLLS THE CONVERSATION to that card (the Conversation tab is shown first when another tab is open), centring it, and HIGHLIGHTS it: the card's frame wears the accent ring (2 px, the focus ring colour) for `constants.highlightMs` ms, then it fades out. No new primitive: StripChip, Menu, MenuRow and the card exist ×4.
